patterns.name: Standard (CLM prefix)
patterns.note: Format: CLM_<creativename>_<cohortname>_<channel-token>_date/month. Channel-token is 'push' for Push and 'Emailer' for Email - separate from the API's 'channel' field which returns 'PUSH'/'EMAIL'.

patterns.name: ADH client (SMS/Email/WhatsApp)
patterns.note: Format: ADH_<BrandName>_<Creative>_<Cohort[_Region]>_OMNI_<Channel>_WK<week>_<DDMMYYYY>. OMNI is a fixed literal segment (ignored for meaning, but required in the name). Channel token is 'SMS'/'EMAIL'/'WA' (WA = WhatsApp) - separate from the API's 'channel' field which returns 'WHATSAPP'. Confirmed against 3 real examples (SMS, Email, WhatsApp) - flag if a legitimately-named campaign from this client ever gets rejected, since this was built from field descriptions rather than a large sample.

naming_convention.note: A campaign passes if its name matches ANY pattern above - lets multiple clients/teams with different naming conventions share this same QA tool without conflicting.

tags_check.note: Flags campaigns with no tags at all - tags are how you filter/report on campaigns later, so an untagged campaign is a QA gap.

segment_sanity.note: Flags all-user campaigns missing an approval tag, and flags targeted campaigns that somehow have zero included audience filters (likely a targeting mistake).

content_check.note: For Push: checks title/message aren't empty per platform (android/ios/web). For Email/SMS/WhatsApp: generic check that there's a reasonable amount of extracted text content (catches an accidentally-empty template). Length threshold is per-channel since SMS/WhatsApp messages are naturally short - falls back to min_total_content_length if a channel isn't listed in min_total_content_length_by_channel.

control_group_check.note: Flags campaigns where neither global nor campaign-level control group is enabled - meaning there's no way to measure this campaign's incremental impact. Disable this if most of your campaigns intentionally skip control groups.

conversion_goal_check.note: Flags campaigns with zero conversion goals, or with zero/multiple goals marked as primary.

delivery_controls_check.note: bypass_dnd flagging is OFF - it's intentional/standard on this team's Fixed-timing campaigns. Set flag_if_bypass_dnd to true if you ever want it back (e.g. to catch it being on for a non-time-critical campaign by mistake).

utm_required.note: Disabled per request. Re-enable (set enabled: true) if you want this back.

utm_mismatch_check.note: Disabled per request. Re-enable if you want to catch drift between campaign-level UTM template and UTMs baked into body links.

link_check.note: Disabled per request - was generating noise from LinkedIn/TikTok blocking bot requests. Re-enable if useful, ideally with a domain ignore-list for social platforms.
